title: Seeding Plates with Mammalian Cells
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare deck and load consumables
steps.instruction: Place an empty reservoir for liquid waste, a 12‑well reservoir (15 mL) containing the solution to be added, tip racks, and any required Eppendorf plate(s) on the deck, and attach the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette to the left mount.

substeps.instruction: Place empty waste reservoir in its designated slot.
Place 12‑well reservoir filled with the dispensing liquid.
Load tip racks for the P300‑Multi.
Position any Eppendorf plate(s) needed for the protocol.
Mount the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette on the left side of the robot.

steps.title: Assign plates to trough wells
steps.instruction: Load up to eight plates onto the deck and assign each plate to a specific well of the 12‑well trough (e.g., slot 1 → plate 1, slot 2 → plate 2, etc.).

substeps.instruction: Place each plate on the deck.
Map plate 1 to trough well 1, plate 2 to trough well 2, and so on for all plates used.

steps.title: Remove 50 µL from each well
steps.instruction: For every plate, use the P300‑Multi to aspirate 50 µL from each well and dispense it into the waste reservoir.

steps.title: Add 140 µL from reservoir
steps.instruction: For every plate, dispense 140 µL of the liquid from the 12‑well reservoir into each well using the P300‑Multi.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol bundle files from the Opentrons website or provided link.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If required, upload any custom labware definition files into the OT‑2 App before loading the protocol.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Import the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck exactly as shown in the protocol’s deck map, placing all labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the tip racks, plates, reservoirs, and the P300‑Multi pipette.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the automated seeding procedure.
